message:
Partial refunds now refund the right amount. In `src/payments/partial-refund.js`, `percent` is documented as 0–100, but the code multiplied the amount by it without dividing by 100. A 50% refund therefore came out 50 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` passes all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
